title: Identification of key apoptosis-related genes and immune infiltration in the pathogenesis of psoriasis.
authors: Zou, Ailing; Kong, Qingtao; Sang, Hong
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过转录组筛选银屑病凋亡相关基因并构建TF-靶基因网络，但核心是疾病基因表达与免疫浸润分析，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Psoriasis is a condition in which skin cells build up and form itchy scales and dry patches. It is also considered a common lifelong disease with an unclear pathogenesis. Furthermore, an effective cure for psoriasis is still unavailable. Reductive apoptosis of keratinocytes and immune infiltration are common in psoriasis. This study aimed to explore underlying functions of key apoptosis-related genes and the characteristics of immune infiltration in psoriasis. We used GSE13355 and GSE30999 to screen differentially expressed apoptosis related genes (DEARGs) in our study. Gene Ontology (GO), Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway, and gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) were performed using clusterProfiler package. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) network was constructed to acquire key DEARGs. Transcription factor (TF)-target and miRNA-mRNA network analyses, drug sensitivity prediction, and immune infiltration were applied. Key DEARGs were validated using real-time quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR). RESULTS: We identified 482 and 32 DEARGs from GSE13355 and GSE30999, respectively. GO analysis showed that DEARGs were commonly enriched in cell chemotaxis, receptor ligand activity, and signaling receptor activator activity. KEGG pathway analysis indicated that viral protein interaction with cytokine and cytokine receptor was maximally enriched pathway. The GSEA analysis of GSE13355 and GSE30999 demonstrated a high consistency degree of enriched pathways. Thirteen key DEARGs with upregulation were obtained in the PPI network. Eleven key DEARGs were confirmed using RT-qPCR. Additionally, 5 TFs and 553 miRNAs were acquired, and three novel drugs were predicted. Moreover, Dendritic.cells.activated exhibited high levels of immune infiltration while Mast.cells.resting showed low levels of immune infiltration in psoriasis groups. CONCLUSION: Results of this study may reveal some insights into the underlying molecular mechanism of psoriasis and provide novel targeted drugs.
abstract_zh: 背景：银屑病是一种皮肤细胞积聚并形成瘙痒鳞屑和干燥斑块的疾病。它也被认为是一种常见的终身性疾病，其发病机制尚不明确。此外，目前仍缺乏有效的银屑病治愈方法。银屑病中常见角质形成细胞凋亡减少和免疫浸润。本研究旨在探讨银屑病中关键凋亡相关基因的潜在功能及免疫浸润特征。我们在研究中使用了GSE13355和GSE30999数据集来筛选差异表达的凋亡相关基因（DEARGs）。利用clusterProfiler包进行了基因本体论（GO）、京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路和基因集富集分析（GSEA）。构建了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络以获取关键DEARGs。应用了转录因子（TF）-靶基因和miRNA-mRNA网络分析、药物敏感性预测及免疫浸润分析。使用实时定量PCR（RT-qPCR）验证了关键DEARGs。结果：我们从GSE13355和GSE30999中分别鉴定出482个和32个DEARGs。GO分析显示，DEARGs普遍富集于细胞趋化性、受体配体活性和信号受体激活因子活性。KEGG通路分析表明，病毒蛋白与细胞因子及细胞因子受体的相互作用是富集程度最高的通路。GSE13355和GSE30999的GSEA分析显示富集通路具有高度一致性。在PPI网络中获得了13个上调的关键DEARGs。通过RT-qPCR确认了11个关键DEARGs。此外，获得了5个TFs和553个miRNAs，并预测了三种新型药物。而且，在银屑病组中，活化的树突状细胞（Dendritic.cells.activated）表现出高水平的免疫浸润，而静息的肥大细胞（Mast.cells.resting）则表现出低水平的免疫浸润。结论：本研究结果可能为银屑病的潜在分子机制提供一些见解，并提供新型靶向药物。
